name: Shotakare!
source:
The story is about a college student heroine who spends her days with her tsundere childhood friend Takeru, Suzumi with a cute smile, and Sayama, who is kind and is like everybody's older brother.
Why are the days you spend with them filled with excitement...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/30145]Freem![/url].]
